summary: Iteration 66 backend tests for Ropa category, multi-mount CRUD, weight-summary per-mount details, carry-move-to-mount auto-deactivate, and toggle_mounted with mount_id. Created /app/backend/tests/test_equipment_multi_mount_ropa_it66.py with 11 test cases. All 11 PASS against the public preview URL.

minor.issue: Response field `mount_id` in return body returns the id of the first mount in the list instead of the currently active rider mount. Not a data bug (the `es_jinete_activo` flags in character.monturas[] are correct) but the response shape is misleading.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Fix response `mount_id` field in PATCH /mounted to reflect active mount (target_id) instead of monturas[0].id.
critical_code_review_comments: character_routes.py equipment/carry correctly sets portado_por and mount_id, and auto-deactivates active items moved to montura. Verified with weapon and inventory items.

character_routes.py weight-summary.monturas_detalle correctly allocates item mass to the mount whose mount_id matches the item; unassigned items fall to the primary mount (monturas[0]). This is acceptable fallback behavior after migrations.
DELETE /monturas/{mount_id} correctly reassigns items (inventario/equipo/armas/armadura_piezas/armadura) from that mount back to personaje and removes mount_id.
POST /monturas generates uuid4 per mount. Consider validating against duplicate names if that is desired business rule.
equipment-catalog returns exactly 24 ropa items, each with posicion in {cabeza,cuerpo,piernas,brazos,pies}. Migration ran correctly.
PATCH /mounted with mount_id correctly flips es_jinete_activo booleans on all mounts; dismount (montado=false) clears all flags.
Regression: POST /rest/short, POST /rest/long, POST /travel/calculate-journey still respond 200 (no 5xx). Existing flows not broken.
Xalan Fuenteoscura migrated data verified: 2 monturas (Poni de Bree, Lúcero) + 3 ropa items in inventario with posicion field.
test_credentials: Not required — equipment/mount/weight-summary endpoints are open.
seed_data_creation: All test data (TEST_mount_*, TEST_item_*, TEST_heavy_*, TEST_espada_*, Botas acolchonadas) is created and cleaned up per-test on Xalan Fuenteoscura (id=208ab2df-a51a-43e5-b96e-1c6757a2ada8). Post-run verification confirms 0 TEST_ items remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file is idempotent — it creates and removes ephemeral weapons/mounts/items on Xalan (208ab2df-a51a-43e5-b96e-1c6757a2ada8). Xalan has 2 mounts (Poni de Bree + Lúcero) and 3 migrated ropa items. Note: tests leave montado=false and es_jinete_activo=false on all mounts after cleanup. If the frontend expects Lúcero to be the default active rider, the main agent may want to re-activate it via PATCH /mounted {montado:true, mount_id:'232c51e3-8d04-46bb-bc5d-5e6b489b39cc'} after testing. Pre-existing KeyError in test_group_speed.py was NOT investigated per request.
